raw_response_text:
{
  "project_id": "P-BFA-EconomicOpportunitiesResilience",
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk_id": "R01",
      "description": "Escalating insecurity and armed conflict may force suspension of field activities, causing project delays and loss of beneficiary reach.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Develop and regularly update security SOPs, shift to remote delivery (radio, phone) in high‑risk zones, and pre‑position staff and resources in safer areas.",
      "evidence": "Annex 3: Adaptation of Project Activities to Insecurity – Red/Black security risk descriptions"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R02",
      "description": "Procurement processes may be delayed by administrative routines and limited bidder competition in fragile regions, affecting timely implementation.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit a qualified procurement specialist, adopt fast‑track procurement procedures in the PIM, and provide targeted training to DMP and bid committees.",
      "evidence": "Key Risks – procurement delays; Annex 2 Procurement Action Plan – need for qualified procurement specialist"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R03",
      "description": "The newly created PIU lacks experienced financial management staff and systems, increasing risk of mis‑allocation of funds.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Hire FM specialist within three months, implement accounting software, and establish internal audit with IGF and ASCELC oversight.",
      "evidence": "Fiduciary – FM assessment notes absence of FM staff, procedures, and software"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R04",
      "description": "Cybersecurity breaches or data protection failures could compromise the Unique Social Registry and interoperable platforms.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Engage ANSSI for security risk assessment, implement encryption and access controls per CIL guidelines, and conduct regular penetration testing.",
      "evidence": "Component 2.2 – security procedures with ANSSI and CIL mentioned"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R05",
      "description": "Construction of warehouses and logistics hubs may cause water and soil pollution from solid and liquid waste.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Apply ESS 3 (Resource Efficiency) standards, require waste management plans in contracts, and monitor compliance through site inspections.",
      "evidence": "Key Risks – water and soil pollution from construction sites"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R06",
      "description": "Sexual exploitation, abuse, and harassment (SEA/SH) risks are substantial given the vulnerable target groups and conflict context.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement an SEA/SH Action Plan, train all staff on code of conduct, and ensure the grievance mechanism can refer survivors to GBV services.",
      "evidence": "Key Risks – SEA/SH risk is Substantial; ESCP requires SEA/SH Action Plan"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R07",
      "description": "Gender‑based violence (GBV) may increase among women beneficiaries, undermining project outcomes and safety.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Recruit a GBV specialist, integrate GBV risk assessments into all activities, and provide safe spaces and referral pathways for survivors.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants – requirement for GBV specialist in PIU"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R08",
      "description": "Climate‑related shocks (droughts, floods) could damage newly built warehouses and disrupt supply chains.",
      "category": "environmental",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Site warehouses in low‑flood zones, incorporate climate‑resilient design standards, and develop emergency repair protocols.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context – climate change undermines food security; Component 3.1 – warehouses built in high‑risk areas"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R09",
      "description": "Inadequate coordination among multiple ministries and partners may lead to fragmented implementation and duplication of effort.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Establish a formal inter‑ministerial coordination committee, define clear roles in the PIM, and hold quarterly joint review meetings.",
      "evidence": "Section B – multiple ministries listed; Lessons Learned – need for stronger coordination"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R10",
      "description": "Delays in meeting pre‑conditions for disbursement (e.g., adoption of Productive Grants Manual) could stall cash flows to beneficiaries.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Create a disbursement readiness checklist, monitor milestones weekly, and provide technical assistance to finalize manuals ahead of deadlines.",
      "evidence": "Disbursement Arrangements – withdrawals contingent on Productive Grants Manual adoption"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R11",
      "description": "Limited mobile network coverage and low phone penetration may hinder digital payments and remote monitoring.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Conduct a telecom coverage mapping, supplement with cash points and agent networks, and retain paper‑based backup mechanisms.",
      "evidence": "Component 2.2 – payment platform considerations include mobile network coverage"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R12",
      "description": "Exclusion of vulnerable groups (women, youth, persons with disabilities, IDPs) from benefits due to targeting errors.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Apply gender‑sensitive targeting criteria, conduct community validation workshops, and monitor inclusion indicators quarterly.",
      "evidence": "Component 1.1 – gender‑sensitive targeting; Key Risks – exclusion of vulnerable groups"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R13",
      "description": "Corruption or fraud in procurement and cash transfers could erode project credibility and financial resources.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 5,
      "mitigation": "Implement strict procurement oversight via ASCELC, use e‑procurement (STEP), and conduct independent audits of grant payments.",
      "evidence": "Procurement – ASCELC oversight; Fiduciary – anti‑corruption guidelines"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R14",
      "description": "Insufficient capacity of social workers and field staff may limit effective delivery of economic inclusion services.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Provide comprehensive training, allocate operational budgets for transport and communication, and monitor performance through M&E dashboards.",
      "evidence": "Component 3.2 – need for training and operating budget for social workers"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R15",
      "description": "Remote monitoring tools (GEMS, PDM, IBM) may face data quality issues in insecure or low‑connectivity areas.",
      "category": "technical",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Combine remote tools with periodic in‑person verification, establish data validation protocols, and train local partners on data entry standards.",
      "evidence": "Annex 3 – remote monitoring adaptations; Monitoring section – use of GEMS, PDM"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R16",
      "description": "Delays in rolling out the Unique Social Registry (RSU) to cover all poor households could limit targeting efficiency.",
      "category": "schedule",
      "likelihood": 4,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Set phased rollout milestones, allocate additional field teams for census sweeps, and monitor coverage percentages monthly.",
      "evidence": "Component 2.1 – RSU currently covers ~1/4 of poor households; goal to reach all"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R17",
      "description": "High turnover or inability to recruit key PIU staff (e.g., gender‑based violence specialist, security specialist) may weaken project governance.",
      "category": "organizational",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Offer competitive contracts, define clear terms of reference, and maintain a backup pool of qualified consultants.",
      "evidence": "Legal Covenants – requirement to recruit GBV and security specialists within 3‑6 months"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R18",
      "description": "Inadequate grievance redress mechanism performance could lead to unresolved complaints and reputational damage.",
      "category": "stakeholder",
      "likelihood": 2,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Establish clear SLA for grievance response, train staff on handling SEA/SH cases, and publish quarterly grievance handling statistics.",
      "evidence": "ESCP – grievance mechanism to be established within 6 months; Key Risks – grievance handling"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R19",
      "description": "Funding reductions from donor partners or humanitarian agencies may create resource gaps for IDP support.",
      "category": "financial",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 4,
      "mitigation": "Secure multi‑year commitments in the trust fund, build contingency buffers in the budget, and explore private‑sector co‑financing for specific components.",
      "evidence": "Strategic Context – recent cuts in humanitarian funding; Funding data shows 0 financing gap but reliance on trust funds"
    },
    {
      "risk_id": "R20",
      "description": "Climate‑related supply chain disruptions (e.g., delayed delivery of inputs for IGAs) could affect beneficiary outcomes.",
      "category": "external",
      "likelihood": 3,
      "impact": 3,
      "mitigation": "Identify alternative local suppliers, pre‑position critical inputs, and incorporate climate risk buffers in procurement timelines.",
      "evidence": "Component 1.1 – reliance on market‑based inputs; Climate change noted as a shock factor"
    }
  ]
}
